## Verse 1

::: {.cline}
<span class="ln"><span class="cw">Sleigh bells </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Eb</span>ring, are you </span><span class="nb"><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Gm</span>listening?</span><span class="cw bare"><span class="ch">Cm</span></span></span></span>
<span class="ln"><span class="cw">In the </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Fm</span>lane, snow is </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Bb</span>glistening</span></span>
<span class="ln"><span class="cw">A </span><span class="nb"><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Gm</span>beautiful s</span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">D9</span>ight, </span></span><span class="cw">we’re </span><span class="nb"><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Gm7</span>happy to</span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">C9#5</span>night</span></span></span>
<span class="ln"><span class="cw"><span class="ch">F9</span>Walking in a </span><span class="nb"><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Bb7</span>winter wonderl</span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Eb</span>and</span></span></span>
:::

## Verse 2

::: {.cline}
<span class="ln"><span class="nb"><span class="cw">Gone a</span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Eb</span>way, </span></span><span class="cw">is the </span><span class="nb"><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Gm</span>bluebird</span><span class="cw bare"><span class="ch">Cm</span></span></span></span>
<span class="ln"><span class="cw">Here to </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Fm</span>stay, is a </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Bb</span>new bird</span></span>
<span class="ln"><span class="cw">He </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Gm</span>sings a love </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">D9</span>song, as </span><span class="nb"><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Gm7</span>we go a</span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">C9#5</span>long</span></span></span>

:::

## Bridge

::: {.cline}
<span class="ln"><span class="cw"><span class="ch">GM7</span>In the meadow </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">AM7/D</span>we can build a </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">GM7</span>snowman</span></span>
<span class="ln"><span class="cw"><span class="ch">G</span>Then pretend that </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">AM7/D</span>he is Parson </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">GM7</span>Brown</span></span>
<span class="ln"><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Bb</span>He’ll say, “Are you </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Cm7/F</span>married?”</span></span>
<span class="ln"><span class="cw">We’ll say, </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Bb</span>“No man, but </span><span class="nb"><span class="cw"><span class="ch">C7</span>you can do the</span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">F7</span> job </span></span><span class="cw">while you’re in </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Bb</span>town”</span></span>
:::

::: {.cline}
